name: 5 shots on the beep (par 5.0s)
notes: Random delay, beep, 5 shots. Striker pistol: splits include rack time.

name: 5-dot sequence (par 8s)
notes: Each shot must hit the next dot in order.

name: Clay trio, shotgun (par 4s)
notes: Shotgun mode forced on; uses the target's spread.

name: IDPA-style familiarization course (5 stages)
notes: Time + points down. Swap the printed target before each stage; the app checks the target ID. Score = raw time + PD x1s + PE x3s + HNT x5s. Lower is better.

stages.name: 1. Basic threat
stages.brief: From the beep: 2 shots to the body -0 circle.

stages.name: 2. Partial hard cover
stages.brief: Lower body is behind black hard cover. 2 shots to exposed -0 / head.

stages.name: 3. Non-threat (hostage)
stages.brief: A non-threat covers the right side. 2 shots on the threat only.

stages.name: 5. Multiple threats
stages.brief: 2 shots each on T1, T2, T3 in order (left to right). Out of order = PE.
